name: fit
title: Fit — how many actors fit on this machine?
summary: Keeps adding small ECMAScript session actors — a set of ids and a resettable timeout — until this machine's memory budget or the latency SLO says stop.
description: Each actor is the common session shape: an ECMAScript datamodel holding a small set of ids and a timeout implemented as a delayed send to itself that every touch cancels and re-arms. The host touches 10% of the sessions per second. The actor count grows (×2 while far from the limits, then ×1.25) while the bench watches its own resident memory against a budget derived from this machine (80% of the memory available at start, or the cgroup limit), the probe latency SLO and whether touches are processed. It reports how many actors fit and what one costs. Tune with --param memoryFraction, memoryMB, sloMs, touchRate, idleMs, maxActors.
